_comment: Between-innings (run-only) upgrades bought in the dugout with run coins. Prices grow by price_growth per purchase and are rounded (10s under 100, 25s above). 'fx' describes the total effect shown in the dugout: value = effect[key] * mult * level.

upgrades.name: Faster Relay
upgrades.text: +10% throw rate and throw speed for the whole team.

upgrades.name: Wider Coverage
upgrades.text: +5% throwing range for the whole team.

upgrades.name: New Pitch Card
upgrades.text: Pick 1 of 3 new cards to add to your deck for this game.

fx.text: Pick a new card for this game

upgrades.name: Base Shield
upgrades.text: +1 shield at home plate. Each shield stops one run (bosses score 3).

upgrades.name: Captain's Rally
upgrades.text: Captain's aura: +10% damage to nearby allies and +2m radius.

upgrades.name: Lucky Bat
upgrades.text: +5% critical hit chance for the whole team.

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.text: +20% coins from outs for the rest of this game.

upgrades.name: Card Mastery
upgrades.text: A random card in your deck gains +1 level for this game.

upgrades.name: Hot Streak
upgrades.text: One defender gains +25% damage for the rest of this game.

upgrades.name: Scouting Report
upgrades.text: Runners have 10% less health for the rest of this game.

upgrades.name: Quick Draw
upgrades.text: Cards are drawn 20% faster and cool down 10% faster.
